name: Enoch
role: Ancient patriarch whose city was taken to God
dateNote: Section 107 says Adam ordained him at twenty-five and that he walked with God 365 years before being translated.
importance: Section 38 has the Lord speak as the one who took “the Zion of Enoch” into his own bosom. Section 45 says his people were received by God as “a city reserved until a day of righteousness”. Sections 84 and 107 place him in the priesthood line from Adam. Section 107 also mentions a book of Enoch to be testified of later.
connections: The D&C names Adam, who ordained him, and Methuselah and Noah among his posterity.
reviewNote: Described only as the D&C presents him. He is also named in 45, 76, 84, 107, and 133; the batch listed only 38.
